plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 970 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.81467, -136.56007, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 6.4 km E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 16 m, about 130 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 220 m N of the spot at 916 m (59.81227, -136.44707). Water: Kelsall Lake 180 m S (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-28, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-07-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R6S-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-28: about 166 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
